params.text: How fast and how far the voltage wanders, 0 to 100%
Adds or subtracts as much as 5V from the output

inputs.text: A CV over the wander rate, attenuated by the RATE knob
A bipolar CV over the offset, attenuverted by the OFFSET knob
A CV over the scaling, attenuated by the SCALE knob
A trigger moves the output to a new random value

outputs.text: The wandering voltage, 5V either way before the offset and scale are applied

notes: polyphony comes from the channels at RATE, or from OFFSET, SCALE or JUMP if one of those is chosen on the menu
menu: Polyphony channels from — chooses which input sets the module's channel count, RATE input, OFFSET input, SCALE input or JUMP input
Jump input action — Jump throws the output to a new random value on each trigger; Sample and hold samples the generator; Track and hold passes the generator through while the gate is high
